"""Inspector on the right of the project list."""

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons import theme
from alloq_commons.components.formatters import de_number
from alloq_commons.components.list_view import (
    badge,
    inspector,
    inspector_section,
    key_values,
    meter,
    plain_button,
    tile,
)
from alloq_commons.components.toolbar import icon_button
from alloq_commons.models.project import Project, TeamMemberBadge
from alloq_project.components.project_parts import project_tile
from alloq_project.states.project_state import ProjectState
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn
from appkit_ui.global_states import LoadingState

MAX_TEAM = 6


def _selected() -> ObjectVar[Project]:
    return ProjectState.inspected.to(Project)


def _open(tab: str) -> list:
    return [
        LoadingState.set_is_loading(True),
        ProjectState.select_project_with_tab(_selected().id, tab),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
    ]


def _heading(project: ObjectVar[Project]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        project_tile(project, large=True),
        mn.stack(
            mn.text(project.name_de, fz="15px", fw=650, lh="1.25", line_clamp=2),
            mn.text(project.customer, fz="11.5px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED, truncate="end"),
            gap=2,
            miw=0,
            flex="1",
        ),
        badge(project.state, ProjectState.inspected_tone),
        gap=12,
        wrap="nowrap",
        align="center",
    )


def _actions() -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        plain_button("Bearbeiten", _open("daten"), flex="1"),
        plain_button("Status erfassen", _open("status"), flex="1"),
        icon_button(
            "calendar-range", "In der Ressourcenplanung öffnen", rx.redirect("/plan")
        ),
        gap=8,
        wrap="nowrap",
    )


def _progress(label: str, value: rx.Var[int], color: str) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.stack(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(label, fz="12.5px"),
            mn.text(value.to(str) + " %", fz="12.5px", style=theme.NUMERIC),
            justify="space-between",
        ),
        meter(value, color),
        gap=4,
    )


def _member(member: ObjectVar[TeamMemberBadge]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.group(
        tile(member.initials, theme.TEXT_TERTIARY, round_=True),
        mn.text(member.name, fz="12.5px", truncate="end", flex="1", miw=0),
        mn.text(
            de_number(
                value=member.planned_pt,
                decimal_scale=2,
                minimum_fraction_digits=2,
                fixed_decimal_scale=True,
                suffix=" PT",
            ),
            fz="11.5px",
            c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
            style=theme.NUMERIC,
            text_wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        gap=9,
        wrap="nowrap",
    )


def _team(project: ObjectVar[Project]) -> rx.Component:
    members = project.team_members.to(list[TeamMemberBadge])
    return inspector_section(
        "Team · " + members.length().to(str),
        rx.cond(
            members.length() > 0,
            mn.stack(rx.foreach(members[:MAX_TEAM], _member), gap=6),
            mn.text(
                "Noch keine Mitarbeiter zugewiesen.", fz="11.5px", c=theme.TEXT_MUTED
            ),
        ),
        rx.cond(
            members.length() > MAX_TEAM,
            mn.text(
                "und " + (members.length() - MAX_TEAM).to(str) + " weitere",
                fz="11.5px",
                c=theme.TEXT_MUTED,
            ),
            rx.fragment(),
        ),

content.text:
The calendar icon in the project inspector now opens the planning page in the project view, filtered to that one project.

**How it works:** clicking the icon calls a new `PlanningStore.open_project(id)` event ([project_inspector.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/project_inspector.py)). It switches the view to "Projekte", sets the project filter to that project and goes to `/plan`. It also clears every other filter that could hide the project: roles, employees, "available only", "hide internal" and both scope toggles.

**Other changes:**
- **Store file split:** the new event pushed `planning_grid_state.py` past the 1000-line limit. I moved the filter fields, their setters, the scope toggles and the filter labels into a new mixin, [planning_filter_mixin.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/states/planning_filter_mixin.py). This follows the same pattern as the display and absence mixins. The store is now 936 lines, and `PROJECT_VIEW` now lives in the mixin.
- **Test:** I added `test_open_project_shows_only_that_project` to [test_planning_project_view_state.py](components/alloq-project/tests/test_planning_project_view_state.py).

All 421 tests pass, and `task lint` and `task typecheck` are clean. I didn't click through it in the running app.

A project with no planned time anywhere won't show in the project view, because that view hides idle projects. You would land on an empty, filtered view in that case.
